DeviceDetail.agentTools.runtime.descript: Device detail client tools can read the current device status, access configuration, metadata, properties, events, documents, alarms, online/offline logs, communication logs, edge gateway read-only diagnostics, and realtime link samples.
The current device defaults to the session subject. Use dynamically registered selector tools only when another device is needed.

Tool results are for evidence collection: use business query tools first for common questions; complex workflows, function invocation, capture, and edge gateway diagnostics are guided by the internal evidence plan.

Some detail tools support writeToPath to write session files and return fs:// references plus inputPath. limit controls inline preview; writeLimit controls paged writes; use writeLimit=0 for full export.
For filtering, aggregation, trajectory extraction, or charting on written JSONL/NDJSON files, use dataset_materialize, dataset_query, or chart tools; do not parse large text with text_regex_extract.
